title: {Syn} AlphaEvolve Used Gemini to Hunt for Algorithms
content:
Google DeepMind introduced AlphaEvolve in 2025 as a Gemini-powered coding agent for designing and improving algorithms.

The headline idea is evolutionary search over programs: propose code, evaluate it, keep the strongest variants, and repeat in domains where objective tests are available.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
